Implementation summary:

- **`src/menu/view.ts`** (new, DOM-free): `rosterRows(save)` sorted by `companionPower` desc (ties → lower id) with `format(power)`, `'Dragon Lv 10'`, `'★×1'` and a `maxLevel` flag; `fuseCandidates(save)` = unordered same-species + same-stars pairs; `canRebirth(save)` = `monsterIndex ≥ REBIRTH_MIN_INDEX`; `consumeTargets(save, foodId)` = every other companion (core's precondition).
- **`src/menu/index.ts`** (new): `mountMenu(doc, api)` over minimal `MenuDocument` / `MenuElement` / `MenuBridge` interfaces. Two-companion actions use a `pending` selection (first click picks the target/twin and the card turns into *Cancel*, second click completes); disabled buttons carry no listener since the page re-renders after every action. No electron/net import — the bridge is the only way out.
- **`static/menu.html`**: `.tabs`/`.tab`/`.panel` × 3, `.footer` Rebirth `.btn`, `.result`, keeping `menu.css` and adding the `dist/web/menu/index.js` module script. Ranking/Battle are placeholders for T49.
- **`tests/menu.test.ts`** (new, 7 tests): the five AC titles verbatim plus button-action and tab tests, driven by a recording fake document (records fills, clicks, children) and a fake bridge.

Two things worth flagging for T49: the Notes' `drawSprite(..., { palette: ... })` call shape isn't literal — `DrawSpriteOptions` has no `palette`, so tier tinting spreads the sprite the way `src/renderer/game.ts` does; and the boot needs module-scoped `declare const document/window` plus a `typeof` guard so the module compiles under the DOM-free test project and imports cleanly in node. I also verified with a throwaway file that the real `Document`/`HTMLCanvasElement`/`HTMLButtonElement` are assignable to the injected interfaces (exit 0, file deleted).
